concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transactions-guide-node]] - Node.js transaction guide distinguishing sale authorization, settlement submission, pre-settlement void, refund, parameter-scoped validation errors, and account-qualified dispute retrieval
warnings: Retain the guide's own authorization, submit for settlement, void, and refund terminology; do not replace settlement with broader capture or payment-success language.
Do not treat `result.success` or the example variable `settledTransaction` as proof of final settlement.
Keep the billing-address recommendation qualified to certain account setups and as improving likelihood, not guaranteeing authorization.
Keep dispute retrieval and subsequent handling qualified by account setup and banking partner.

concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transactions-guide-node]] - Braintree Node.js transaction-level route to account-qualified dispute details on the transaction response, disputed-transaction search by dispute date, and banking-partner-dependent handling
warnings: This guide supports transaction-level retrieval navigation only; it does not define dispute lifecycle stages, evidence actions, eligibility, deadlines, or outcomes.
Preserve `zero or more disputes` and the account-setup qualification; do not imply every transaction exposes a dispute or every merchant has the same retrieval path.
Do not import PayPal Disputes API terminology or behavior into this Braintree guide route.
